# Open Ontology

> A small, closed language for domain models, built to be written by agents and owned by people. It has four declarations (entities, relations, actions, queries) and four changes (create, set, clear, link). A model compiles to one portable JSON IR and runs actions as transactions and queries as Datalog on Triplex. v0.1: one package, local in-memory runtime, not on npm.

Open Ontology is WorldVM's world model (https://worldvm.com). It works without WorldVM: it runs on Triplex directly, and `@worldvm/*` packages are not published yet.

If you are an agent modeling a domain for someone, read the agent guide first. It is one plain-text file with the full grammar, a modeling procedure, the check command, the runtime semantics and the limits, and it is tested against v0.1.

## Docs

- [Agent guide](/llms-full.txt): everything needed to write, check and run a model
- [README](https://github.com/bjacobso/open-ontology/blob/main/README.md): install, scripts and package boundary
- [Architecture](https://github.com/bjacobso/open-ontology/blob/main/docs/architecture.md): TypeScript/Forma → IR → Triplex adapter
- [WorldVM](https://github.com/bjacobso/open-ontology/blob/main/docs/worldvm.md): how the IR, actions and queries map onto WorldVM's proposed kernel

## Examples

- [Support desk](https://github.com/bjacobso/open-ontology/tree/main/examples/support-desk): create, clear+set, references, relations, negation, ordering, aggregates
- [Field service](https://github.com/bjacobso/open-ontology/tree/main/examples/field-service): the same model in TypeScript and Forma, checked for identical IR

## Source

- [IR types](https://github.com/bjacobso/open-ontology/blob/main/src/ir.ts): the portable JSON contract
- [Model checker](https://github.com/bjacobso/open-ontology/blob/main/scripts/check-model.ts): `pnpm model:check <file>`, located errors and lint
- [Runtime](https://github.com/bjacobso/open-ontology/blob/main/src/runtime.ts): actions → Triplex transactions, named Datalog queries
